blocked_transition: not accepted and never a trajectory parent
interpretation: fewer than three accepted transitions is EXPERIMENT_BLOCKED and is not evidence of no structural drift
on_accept: record independent structural evidence; exact accepted commit/tree is next parent; continue unless O4 complete
on_environment_failure: environment-only retry solely on proved non-exercise; otherwise stop EXPERIMENT_BLOCKED
on_harness_mismatch: stop and invalidate Run 3 entry/execution; do not edit gate after generation
on_instrumentation_limitation: block affected inference; if required discrimination is unavailable stop EXPERIMENT_BLOCKED
on_repair_failure: reject transition, stop, final EXPERIMENT_BLOCKED when fewer than 3 accepted
on_structural_invariant_failure: record and continue when ordinary gates pass; never reject unless objective explicitly made it a task contract
trajectory: T0 -> T1 -> T2 -> T3, with O4 available for T4
